entries.title: Ezekiel 12:1
segments: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:2
segments: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not, which have ears to hear, and hear not; for they are a rebellious house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:3
segments: And thou, son of man, prepare thee a captive's baggage, and go captive by day in their sight; and thou shalt go captive from thy place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:4
segments: And bring forth thy baggage by day in their sight, as a captive's baggage, and thou thyself, go forth at even in their sight as they that go forth into captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:5
segments: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:6
segments: In their sight shalt thou bear [it] upon [thy] shoulder, and carry it forth in the dark; thou shalt cover thy face, and thou shalt not see the ground: for I have appointed thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:7
segments: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my baggage by day, as a captive's baggage, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the dark, [and] bore it upon [my] shoulder, in their sight.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:8
segments: And in the morning the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:9
segments: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:10
segments: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This burden [concerneth] the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:11
segments: Say, I am your sign: as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall go into exile, into captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:12
segments: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon [his] shoulder in the dark, and shall go forth; they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby; he shall cover his face, that he see not the land with [his] eyes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:13
segments: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; but he shall not see it, and there shall he die.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:14
segments: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his troops; and I will draw out the sword after them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:15
segments: And they shall know that I [am] Jehovah when I shall scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:16
segments: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the nations whither they shall come; and they shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:17
segments: ¶And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:18
segments: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with anxiety;

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:19
segments: and say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, in the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with anxiety, and drink their water with astonishment, because her land shall be left desolate of all that is in it, for the violence of all them that dwell therein.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:20
segments: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be a desolation; and ye shall know that I [am] Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:21
segments: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:22
segments: Son of man, what is that proverb which ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days shall be prolonged, and every vision faileth?

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:23
segments: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the accomplishment of every vision.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:24
segments: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination in the midst of the house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:25
segments: For I [am] Jehovah; I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be performed, it shall be no more deferred. For in your days, O rebellious house, will I speak the word and will perform it, saith the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:26
segments: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:27
segments: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days, and he prophesieth of times that are far off.

entries.title: Ezekiel 12:28
segments: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be deferred any more, but the word that I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah.
